∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀
                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  ∀ (batch : ℕ) (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                    MeasurableSet E →
                      (∀ z ∈ E,
                          ∃ x y clock firstID,
                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch =
                              some (false, x, y, clock, firstID)) →
                        have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                        ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                            ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∂P ≤
                          4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.S * P E

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀
                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  ∀ (batch : ℕ) (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                    MeasurableSet E →
                      (∀ z ∈ E,
                          ∃ x clock firstID,
                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch =
                              some (true, x, x, clock, firstID)) →
                        have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                        ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                            ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∂P ≤
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ q.m * P E

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample q.m q.n →
            ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
              Monotone τ →
                ∀
                  (O :
                    OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                    ∀ (batch : ℕ) (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                      MeasurableSet E →
                        (∀ z ∈ E,
                            ∃ x clock firstID,
                              outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch =
                                some (true, x, x, clock, firstID)) →
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                              ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∂P ≤
                            5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.m * P E

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (z.2 a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (full : Bool) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch = some (full, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchEndCall q O z.1 z.2 batch).isSome = true ∧
                    (if full = true then
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace q.n (List.ofFn id) 0 0
                            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartedRows q O batch z)
                            (fun a r => outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartAnswer q O batch a r z)
                            (q.n * q.m)).clock
                      else
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.differenceTrace q.n q.S 0 0 0
                            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartedRows q O batch z)
                            (fun a r => outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartAnswer q O batch a r z)
                            q.S).clock) =
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch
